events.text: You've been in the same role for years. Promotions pass you by and you wonder if this is as far as you climb.

choices.label: Ask your manager for a development plan
choices.resultText: The conversation was awkward but honest. A path forward emerged.

choices.label: Accept the plateau and focus on stability
choices.resultText: Less ambition, less stress. You made peace with the ceiling.

choices.label: Start looking elsewhere
choices.resultText: Updated résumé, new listings. Change might be overdue.

events.text: Your last child moves out. The house is quiet in a way it hasn't been in decades.

choices.label: Celebrate their independence
choices.resultText: Pride outweighed the silence. You raised someone ready to fly.

choices.label: Redecorate their old room immediately
choices.resultText: A home office, finally. The past made space for the present.

choices.label: Feel the loss deeply
choices.resultText: Meals for one. You called more often than they needed.

events.text: You visit your aging parent and notice they're slower, frailer, and forgetting small things.

choices.label: Schedule a thorough check-up for them
choices.resultText: The doctor had answers. You felt less helpless.

choices.label: Spend the day reminiscing
choices.resultText: Old photos and stories. Time felt precious.

choices.label: Cut the visit short — it's too hard
choices.resultText: You drove away guilty. Avoidance doesn't slow the clock.

events.text: A routine check-up flags something concerning. The doctor wants follow-up tests.

choices.label: Get every test done promptly
choices.resultText: Results came back manageable. Relief hit like a wave.

choices.label: Ignore it for now
choices.resultText: The worry faded until a symptom reminded you.

choices.label: Overhaul your lifestyle immediately
choices.resultText: Less salt, more steps. Small changes felt like reclaiming control.

events.text: Your university class reunion is this weekend. Names you haven't spoken in years appear on the guest list.

choices.label: Go and reconnect
choices.resultText: Awkward hellos became real laughter. You remembered who you were.

choices.label: Skip it — you've moved on
choices.resultText: Photos flooded social media. A twinge of curiosity lingered.

choices.label: Attend but leave early
choices.resultText: One drink, a few handshakes. Enough nostalgia for one night.

events.text: A colleague you've competed with for years gets the promotion you wanted. The announcement email lands in everyone's inbox.

choices.label: Congratulate them sincerely
choices.resultText: Grace cost you pride. Your reputation stayed intact.

choices.label: Confront your boss privately
choices.resultText: Feedback stung. At least you know where you stand.

choices.label: Channel the anger into your work
choices.resultText: Late nights, sharper output. Next time, maybe.

events.text: You're stretched between aging parents who need help and children who still depend on you. Everyone wants a piece of your time.

choices.label: Set boundaries and share the load
choices.resultText: Sibling, spouse, community — you learned to delegate.

choices.label: Drop everything for family
choices.resultText: Exhaustion became your normal. They felt loved.

choices.label: Prioritise your own wellbeing
choices.resultText: Guilt followed, but you couldn't pour from an empty cup.

events.text: You realise you haven't picked up a hobby purely for joy in years. A flyer for pottery, hiking, or guitar lessons catches your eye.

choices.label: Sign up this week
choices.resultText: Clumsy beginnings, genuine delight. You had forgotten how fun learning felt.

choices.label: Bookmark it for later
choices.resultText: Later never came. The flyer yellowed on the fridge.

choices.label: Turn it into a side hustle
choices.resultText: Joy mixed with spreadsheets. Maybe that was the point.

events.text: A friend from your twenties reaches out after years of silence. They want to meet for coffee and catch up.

choices.label: Meet them with open arms
choices.resultText: Stories overlapped and diverged. The friendship picked up where it left off.

choices.label: Keep it polite but guarded
choices.resultText: Pleasant hour, careful topics. Trust rebuilt slowly.

choices.label: Decline — too much water under the bridge
choices.resultText: Some doors stay closed for good reason.

events.text: Performance reviews are due. You've carried extra work all year and believe you deserve a raise.

choices.label: Make a strong case with numbers
choices.resultText: They met you partway. Not everything, but progress.

choices.label: Accept whatever they offer
choices.resultText: Politeness cost you money. Resentment simmered quietly.

choices.label: Threaten to leave if undervalued
choices.resultText: High stakes poker. You won a bump — and a wary manager.

events.text: A younger colleague asks you to mentor them. They see experience in you that you sometimes forget you have.

choices.label: Take them under your wing
choices.resultText: Teaching refreshed your own skills. They flourished.

choices.label: Offer occasional advice only
choices.resultText: Quick tips over coffee. Enough without the commitment.

choices.label: Decline — you're too busy
choices.resultText: They found someone else. You wondered what you missed.

events.text: Your anniversary approaches and you catch yourself wondering if you and your partner have grown apart.

choices.label: Plan something meaningful together
choices.resultText: Old jokes resurfaced. The distance felt bridgeable.

choices.label: Suggest couples counselling
choices.resultText: Hard conversations in a neutral room. A start.

choices.label: Say nothing and let the day pass
choices.resultText: Another year, another quiet dinner. The doubt grew.

events.text: A friend invites you to a fitness challenge — a 5K, a gym streak, or a step-count competition.

choices.label: Commit and train seriously
choices.resultText: Sore muscles, better sleep. You crossed the finish line proud.

choices.label: Join half-heartedly
choices.resultText: Some effort beat none. Progress was modest but real.

choices.label: Decline — your body isn't what it was
choices.resultText: The couch won. So did the creeping stiffness.

events.text: A local charity needs volunteers on weekends. You have skills and time you've never offered before.

choices.label: Sign up for regular shifts
choices.resultText: Purpose outside work. Strangers became familiar faces.

choices.label: Donate money instead of time
choices.resultText: The cheque helped. You still wondered about showing up.

choices.label: Pass — your plate is full
choices.resultText: The flyer went in the bin. Life stayed unchanged.

events.text: A business idea or creative project keeps you awake at night. It could be a blog, a shop, or an app.

choices.label: Launch a small pilot
choices.resultText: Rough edges, real feedback. You finally tried.

choices.label: Research but don't commit yet
choices.resultText: Spreadsheets and notes piled up. Action waited.

choices.label: Talk yourself out of it
choices.resultText: Too risky, too late. The idea faded by morning.

events.text: Your parent is hospitalised suddenly. Decisions about care, bills, and siblings fall on your shoulders.

choices.label: Take charge of their care
choices.resultText: Sleepless nights in waiting rooms. They knew you showed up.

choices.label: Coordinate remotely with siblings
choices.resultText: Video calls and shared spreadsheets. Imperfect but shared.

choices.label: Struggle to cope and withdraw
choices.resultText: Guilt compounded grief. Healing would take time.

events.text: Your adult child asks to move back home — job loss, divorce, or savings running out.

choices.label: Welcome them with clear rules
choices.resultText: Chores, rent, deadlines. Tough love under one roof.

choices.label: Offer financial help but not a room
choices.resultText: Support without surrendering your space. Boundaries held.

choices.label: Refuse — they need to stand alone
choices.resultText: The argument was bitter. Independence cut both ways.

events.text: The family home feels too large now. You start browsing smaller places and calculating what you'd save.

choices.label: List the house and downsize
choices.resultText: Less yard, less upkeep. Freedom in fewer rooms.

choices.label: Stay — too many memories here
choices.resultText: Empty bedrooms stayed empty. Nostalgia won the debate.

choices.label: Rent out a spare room instead
choices.resultText: A stranger's footsteps in the hall. Compromise income.

events.text: You've postponed a dream trip for years — kids, work, bills always came first. The destination still calls.

choices.label: Book it finally
choices.resultText: Passport stamped, photos taken. Worth every penny you saved.

choices.label: Save another year
choices.resultText: The spreadsheet said wait. The calendar turned again.

choices.label: Let the dream go
choices.resultText: Some windows close. You made peace — mostly.

events.text: Exhaustion hits bone-deep. Even small tasks feel impossible and Sunday nights fill you with dread.

choices.label: Take medical leave and rest
choices.resultText: Weeks off the hamster wheel. You remembered what rested felt like.

choices.label: Push through — bills don't pause
choices.resultText: You showed up hollow. Something had to give eventually.

choices.label: Negotiate reduced hours
choices.resultText: Less pay, more air. A fragile balance.

events.text: Your industry is changing fast. A short course in new tools or methods could keep you relevant.

choices.label: Enrol and complete it
choices.resultText: Certificates and confidence. You weren't obsolete yet.

choices.label: Learn free resources online
choices.resultText: YouTube and forums filled gaps. Good enough for now.

choices.label: Decide experience beats training
choices.resultText: Younger hires spoke a language you didn't. The gap widened.

events.text: You bump into someone you drifted from years ago. Apologies are awkward but the warmth is still there.

choices.label: Exchange numbers and meet again
choices.resultText: Lunch turned into hours. Old bonds can be rebuilt.

choices.label: Enjoy the moment and move on
choices.resultText: A good conversation, no promises. Enough for one day.

choices.label: Keep walking — the past stays past
choices.resultText: Polite nods. Some chapters stay closed.

events.text: You lie awake asking what you'll leave behind — children, work, community, or nothing at all.

choices.label: Start a project that outlasts you
choices.resultText: A scholarship, a garden, a book — something with your name on it.

choices.label: Invest more in relationships
choices.resultText: Legacy as love given daily. Simpler than monuments.

choices.label: Decide legacy is a young person's worry
choices.resultText: The question returned at 3 a.m. anyway.

events.text: You sit down with bank statements and realise retirement and emergencies need a honest reckoning.

choices.label: Build a strict savings plan
choices.resultText: Spreadsheets, automatic transfers. Future-you might thank present-you.

choices.label: Consult a financial adviser
choices.resultText: Jargon translated into steps. Less panic, more plan.

choices.label: Close the laptop and hope for the best
choices.resultText: Ignorance felt lighter until the next bill arrived.

events.text: An ordinary evening — a meal, a sunset, a message from someone you love — stops you mid-step.

choices.label: Pause and feel it fully
choices.resultText: Brief and overwhelming. You were luckier than you remembered.

choices.label: Text someone you appreciate
choices.resultText: A few words sent ripples. Gratitude shared multiplies.

choices.label: Shrug it off — life goes on
choices.resultText: The moment passed unmarked. Busy tomorrow anyway.
